senses.gloss:
शप् 1. शप्, a technical term, used by Pā-
ṇini for the Vi-karaṇa अ, inserted between the root
and terminations of the conjugational tenses in the
1st class, &c. See वि-करण.

शप् 2. शप्, ind. a particle and prefix im-
plying assent or acceptance, as in शप्-करोति, he
admits or accepts.

शप् 3. शप्, cl. 1. 4. P. A. शपति, -ते,
शप्यति, -ते, शशाप, शेपे, शप्स्यति, -ते,
अशाप्सीत्, अशप्त, शप्तुम् (according to some per-
haps originally ‘to cry aloud’), to curse, imprecate
evil, execrate; to revile, scold, blame (with dat.);
to take an oath, swear, promise or asseverate by
oath: Caus. शापयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अशीशपत्, to
cause or order to swear (with inst. of object by which
one is sworn); to conjure: Desid. शिशप्सति, -ते: In-
tens. शाशप्यते (according to Vopa-deva XX. 8. also
शंशप्यते), शाशप्ति; [cf. perhaps Gr. κόμπος.]

सप् सप् (probably connected with rt.
सच् and सपर्य), cl. 1. P. सपति, स-
साप, सपितुम्, Ved. to worship, honour, serve,
follow, (in Naigh. III. 5. सपति is placed among
the परिचरण-कर्माणः, and in Naigh. III. 14.
among the अर्चति-कर्माणः); to conform to; to
join or unite together, connect (= समवाये); to
obtain, (Sāy. = प्राप्); to touch, sip, (Sāy. सपन्त
= स्पृशन्ति, Ṛg-veda V. 3, 4); to perform, do,
(Sāy. = कृ): Caus. सपयति, -यितुम्, to follow,
worship, (Ved. सीषपन्त = परिचरणं कुर्-
वन्तु); [cf. Gr. σέβομαι, σέβας, σεμνός, ἔπομαι;
Goth. siponeis, ‘a pupil.]

शप, अस्, m. an imprecation, curse, cursing; an
oath; a corpse, (for शव, q. v.)

शाप शाप, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 3. शप्), curse, ana-
thema, execration, cursing, reviling; abuse; oath,
imprecation, affirmation by oath or ordeal; ban,
interdiction.
—शाप-ग्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, seized by a
curse, suffering under a curse.
—शाप-ज, अस्, आ,
अम्, arising from a curse.
—शाप-नाशन, अस्, m.,
N. of a Muni.
—शाप-प्रद, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘curse-
giving,’ uttering imprecations.
—शाप-भीत, अस्, आ,
अम्, dreading a curse.
—शाप-मुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
released from a curse.
—शाप-मुक्ति, इस्, f. or शाप-
मोक्ष, अस्, m. deliverance from a curse.
—शाप-यन्-
त्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, restrained by a curse.
—शापान्त
(˚प-अन्˚) or शापावसान (˚प-अव्˚), अस्, m. the
end of a curse or of the period during which an im-
precation takes effect.
—शापास्त्र (˚प-अस्˚), अस्, m.
‘having curses for weapons,’ a Muni, saint, (a curse
pronounced by a Muni being formidable even to the
deities.)
—शापोत्सर्ग (˚प-उत्˚), अस्, m. ‘pouring
out a curse,’ the uttering of an imprecation.
—शा-
पोद्धार (˚प-उद्˚), अस्, m. deliverance from a
curse.

सप सप, अस्, m., Ved. (probably) the
organ of generation; [cf. शेप.]
शपत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, cursing, reviling, swearing.

सपत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, honouring, worshipping, fol-
lowing; obtaining.

शपथ, अस्, m. cursing, imprecating; an impre-
cation, curse, anathema; an oath, administering an
[]
oath, swearing, asseveration by oath or ordeal; con-
juration.
—शपथ-पत्त्र, अम्, n. written testi-
mony on oath, an affidavit.

शपन, अम्, n. the act of imprecation, cursing,
malediction; reviling, abuse; an oath, asseveration by
oath or ordeal.

शपमान, अस्, आ, अम्, cursing, reviling, impre-
cating, swearing.

सापमान सापमान (स-अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
with contempt, contemptuous; (अम्), ind. contemp-
tuously.

शप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, cursed, reviled, abused, anathe-
matized; sworn, taken as an oath; (अस्), m. a sort
of grass, Saccharum Cylindricum.

सप्त, अस्, ई, अम्, (according to Śabda-k.) = सप्-
तम, the seventh.
शप्त्वा, ind. having cursed or reviled, having sworn.

शापित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to take an oath, one
to whom an oath has been administered, sworn,
adjured, proved by ordeal.
शापेय, see Gaṇa Śaunakādi to Pāṇ. IV. 3, 106.

शापेयिन्, ई, m. a proper N.; (इनस्), m. pl., N.
of a school of the White Yajur-veda.
शापठिक शापठिक, अस्, m. a peacock.

सपर्य (probably fr. a lost noun सपस् = Gr. σέβας,
cf. सबस्), Nom. P. सपर्यति, -यितुम्, Ved.
to worship, adore, honour, serve, (in Naigh. III. 5.
सपर्यति is enumerated among the परिचरण-
कर्माणः.)
सपर्य सपर्य. See under rt. सप्.
सपर्या, f. worship, adoration, reverence.
सपर्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. worshipping, serving.

सपर्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. serving, honouring,
adoring.

सपक्ष स-पक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, having wings,
winged; having a side or party; being on the same
side, belonging to the same party; containing the
major term or subject; (अस्), m. a partisan, follower,
adherent; (in logic) an instance on the same side
(e. g. the common illustration of ‘the culinary
hearth’), a similar instance or one in which the
major term is found.

सपताक स-पताक, अस्, आ, अम्, having a
banner, with a banner.

सपत्तन स-पत्तन, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing
towns or cities.

सपत्त्रलेख स-पत्त्रलेख, अस्, आ, अम्, having
fragrant pigments.

सपत्त्राकृ स-पत्त्रा-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति,
-कर्तुम्, to wound with an arrow or other feathered
weapon in such a way that the feathers enter the
body.

सपत्त्रा-करण, अम्, n. wounding so that the
feathered part of an arrow enters the body, causing
excessive pain, worrying any one to death.

सपत्त्रा-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, (according to some
also सपत्त्र-कृत), severely wounded or pained,
excessively afflicted; (अस्), m. a deer or other animal
severely wounded.

सपत्त्रा-कृति, इस्, f. great agony or affliction;
excessive pain or distress.

सपत्न स-पत्न, अस्, आ, अम्, (said by some
to be fr. स-पत्नी below, but regarded by others as
a separate word and connected with rt. सप् above, in
the sense of ‘following,’ ‘persecuting’), hostile; (अस्),
m. an enemy, adversary, rival.
—सपत्न-ता, f.
enmity, rivalry.
—सपत्न-हन्, आ, -घ्नी, अ, Ved.
killing enemies, destroying rivals.
—सपत्नारि (˚न-
अरि), इस्, m. a sort of bamboo, Bambusa Spinosa.

सापत्न सापत्न, अस्, ई, अम्, (fr. स-पत्नी),
born from a rival wife, belonging to fellow-wives;
(आस्), m. pl. the children of different wives of the
same husband.

स-पत्नी, f. a woman who has the same husband
with another woman (Pāṇ. IV. 1, 35) or whose
husband has other wives, a fellow wife, rival wife,
cotemporary wife, rival mistress.
—सपत्नी-तस्,
ind. from a rival wife.
—सपत्नी-त्व, अम्, n. the
state of a woman whose husband has other wives.
—सपत्नी-दुहितृ, ता, f. the daughter of a rival
wife.
—सपत्नी-पुत्र, अस्, m. the son of a rival
wife.

स-पत्नीक, अस्, m. accompanied with a wife,
along with a wife.

सपदि स-पदि, ind. at the same instant,
[]
instantly, in a moment, at the moment, immediately;
quickly, swiftly.

सपद्म स-पद्म, अस्, आ, अम्, furnished with
lotuses, having lotuses.

सपन्नग स-पन्नग, अस्, आ, अम्, furnished
with serpents.

सपराक्रम स-पराक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, having
valour, valiant, brave, bold.

सपरिकर स-परिकर, अस्, आ, अम्, attended
by a retinue.

सपरिच्छद स-परिच्छद, अस्, आ, अम्, attended
by a train, provided with necessaries.

सपरिजन स-परिजन, अस्, आ, अम्, having
attendants, accompanied by followers.

सपरितोष स-परितोष, अस्, आ, अम्, feeling
satisfaction, much pleased.

सपरिवार स-परिवार, अस्, आ, अम्, attended
by a retinue, having a multitude of dependants.

सपरिवाह स-परिवाह, अस्, आ, अम्, having
an overflow, overflowing, brimful.

सपरिशेष स-परिशेष, अस्, आ, अम्, having
a remainder, with the remainder, with the rest.

सपरिषत्क स-परिषत्क, अस्, m. a teacher
surrounded by a college of his own disciples.

सपर्वतवनद्रुम स-पर्वत-वन-द्रुम, अस्,
आ, अम्, with mountains, forests, and trees.
—स-
पर्वत-वनार्णव (˚न-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, pos-
sessing mountains, forests, and seas (said of the
earth).

सपलाश स-पलाश, अस्, आ, अम्, together
with a Palāśa tree.

सपल्लव स-पल्लव, अस्, आ, अम्, together
with shoots, having branches.

सपवित्रक स-पवित्रक, अस्, आ, अम्, con-
taining sacrificial grass.

स-पादपीठ, अस्, आ, अम्, furnished with a foot-
stool.

सपादुक स-पादुक, अस्, आ, अम्, wearing
shoes, wearing sandals; with shoes or sandals.

सपिण्ड स-पिण्ड, अस्, m. ‘having the same
Piṇḍa,’ a kinsman connected by the offering of the
funeral cake to the Manes of certain relations (viz.
father, grandfather, great-grandfather, &c., including
the direct descendants of four persons, or, according to
others, seven persons in an ascending and descending
line: the following are therefore called Sapiṇḍas —
son, son's son, and son's grandson; widow, daughter,
and daughter's son; father, mother, brother, brother's
son, brother's grandson; father's daughter's son;
father's brother's son and grandson; paternal grand-
father's daughter's son; paternal grandfather; paternal
grandmother, paternal grandfather's brother, brother's
son and grandson; great grandfather's daughter's
son).
—सपिण्ड-ता, f. the condition of being a Sa-
piṇḍa.
—सपिण्डी-करण, अम्, n. investing a person
with the rights of a Sapiṇḍa or kinsman (as described
above); performing the Śrāddha to deceased relatives
called Sapiṇḍas (at the end of a full year after the
death of a relative).
—सपिण्डी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्,
invested with the relationship of Sapiṇḍa.
सपिण्डन, अम्, n. = सपिण्डी-करण.

सपित्व स-पित्व, according to Sāy. सपित्वम्
= सह-प्राप्तव्यं स्थानम्, ‘a place to be ob-
tained together,’ (Ṛg-veda 1. 109, 7.)

सपिशाच स-पिशाच, अस्, आ, अम्, together
with or accompanied by the Piśācas.

सपीड स-पीड, अस्, आ, अम्, suffering pain or
anguish, painful.

सपीतक स-पीतक, अस्, m. a kind of plant
(= राज-कोषातकी).
स-पीतिका, f. a kind of creeper (= हस्ति-घोषा).

सपीति स-पीति, इस्, f. compotation, drinking
together, drinking in company; (इस्, इस्, इ), Ved. one
who drinks together, a boon-companion.

सपुत्र स-पुत्र or स-पुत्रक, अस्, आ, अम्,
having a son, accompanied by a son.
—स-पुत्र-
दार, अस्, आ, अम्, with son and wife, accompanied
by son and wife.

स-पुत्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, together with sons, accom-
panied by sons.

सपुरोहित स-पुरोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, accom-
panied by a family priest.

सपुष्प स-पुष्प, अस्, आ, अम्, having flowers,
blooming.

स-पुष्प-बलि, इस्, इस्, इ, filled with offerings of
flowers.

सपौर स-पौर, अस्, आ, अम्, accompanied
by citizens.

सप्तन् सप्तन्, अ, m. f. n. pl. (in Uṇādi-s. 1.
156. said to be fr. rt. सप्, ‘to connect, join’),
seven, (a favourite number with the Hindūs, and
regarded as a sacred number; hence mention is
made of seven Mātṛs, seven streams, seven oceans,
seven cities [Ṛg-veda 1. 63, 7], seven divisions of
the world, seven Ṛṣis, seven Vipras [Ṛg-veda 1.
62, 4], seven Ādityas, seven Dānavas, seven horses
of the Sun, seven flames or tongues of fire, seven
Yonīs of fire, seven Samidhs, seven tones, seven
sacrificial rites, seven Maryādās, thrice seven Padāni
or mystical steps by which heaven is obtained [Ṛg-
veda 1. 72, 6], thrice seven cows, &c.); [cf. Zend
हप्त; Gr. ἑπτά; Lat. septem; Goth. sibun;
Angl. Sax. seofon; Lith. septyni, septynios; Slav.
sedmij; Hib. seacht; Cambro-Brit. saith; Armor.
seiz.]
—सप्त-ऋषि, अयस्, m. pl. ‘the seven Ṛṣis,’
epithet of the authors of the hymn Ṛg-veda IX. 107.
—सप्त-कोण, अस्, आ, अम्, septangular, heptagonal.
—सप्त-गङ्गम्, ind. the place of the seven streams
of the Gaṅgā, (Pāṇ. II. 1, 20; cf. पञ्च-नद.)
—सप्त-गु, उस्, m., N. of an Āṅgirasa (author of
the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 47).
—सप्त-गोदावरम्,
ind. the place of the seven streams of the Godā-
varī.
—सप्त-ग्रही, f. the meeting of the seven
planets under one sign.
—सप्त-चक्र, अस्, आ, अम्,
having seven wheels, (according to Śaṅkara = सर्-
पण-चक्र.)
—सप्तचत्वारिंश, अस्, ई, अम्, the
47th.
—सप्त-चत्वारिंशत्, त्, f., 47.
—सप्त-
च्छद, अस्, m. ‘having seven leaves,’ a kind of tree
[cf. सप्त-पर्ण]; (आ), f. a species of plant (=
मद-गन्ध).
—सप्त-जानि or सप्त-जामि, इस्,
इस्, इ, Ved. (probably) having seven brothers or
sisters.
—सप्त-जिह्व, अस्, m. ‘seven-tongued,’ epi-
thet of Agni or fire, (the seven tongues of fire have
all names, e. g. काली, कराली, मनो-जवा, सु-लोहिता,
सु-धूम्र-वर्णा, उग्रा or स्फुलिङ्गिनी, प्र-
दीप्ता, and these names vary according to the parti-
cular rite in which fire is used, see हिरण्या, सु-
वर्णा, सु-प्रभा, &c.)
—सप्त-ज्वाल, अस्, m.
‘seven-flamed,’ epithet of Agni or fire.
—सप्त-
तन्तु, उस्, m. ‘having seven performers,’ a sacrifice,
offering, oblation, (Sāy. = सप्त तनितारः, i. e.
कर्मणां विस्तारयितारो यस्य.)
—सप्तत्रिंश,
अस्, ई, अम्, the 37th.
—सप्त-त्रिंशत्, त्, f., 37.
—सप्तदश, अस्, ई, अम्, the 17th; having 17
properties or attributes (said of a कुल or family);
(अस्), m., scil. स्तोम, epithet of a particular Stoma;
N. of a collection of hymns (said to have been
created from Brahmā's western mouth).
—सप्त-
दशन्, अ, m. f. n. pl., 17.
—सप्त-दीधिति, इस्, m.
[]
‘having seven rays of light,’ epithet of Agni.
—सप्त-द्वारावकीर्ण (˚र-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, con-
fined within seven gates (i. e. according to Kullūka,
confined to the five organs of sense, the mind and
the intellect, or restricted to this world and the three
above and the three below it, Manu VI. 48).
—सप्त-द्वीप, आस्, m. pl. the seven divisions of
the terrestrial world, see द्वीप; (आ), f. ‘having or
consisting of seven Dvīpas,’ epithet of the earth.
—सप्तद्वीप-पति, इस्, m. the lord of the seven
Dvīpas.
—सप्त-द्वीप-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, containing
or consisting of seven Dvīpas.
—सप्त-धातु, उस्,
उस्, उ, consisting of seven elements, sevenfold, con-
taining seven; (अवस्), m. pl. the seven constituent
elements of the body (viz. chyle, blood, flesh, fat,
bone, marrow, and semen).
—सप्त-धातुक, अस्,
आ, अम्, = सप्त-धातु.
—सप्त-धारा-तीर्थ, अम्,
n., N. of a place.
—सप्तनवत, अस्, ई, अम्, the 97th.
—सप्त-नवति, इस्, f., 97.
—सप्तनवति-तम,
अस्, ई, अम्, the 97th.
—सप्त-नाडी-चक्र, अम्, n.
an astrological diagram supposed to foretell rain, (it
consists of seven serpentine lines marked with the
names of the Nakṣatras and planets.)
—सप्त-ना-
मन्, आ, आ, अ, having seven names.
—सप्त-नामा,
f. a kind of plant (= आदित्य-भक्ता).
—सप्तपञ्-
चाश, अस्, ई, अम्, the 57th.
—सप्त-पञ्चाशत्, त्, f.,
57.
—सप्त-पत्त्र, अस्, m. ‘seven-leaved,’ a kind
of plant (-मुद्गर).
—सप्त-पद, अस्, आ, or ई,
अम्, having seven steps, containing seven Padas; (ई),
f. the seven steps at marriage.
—सप्त-पदार्थी, f., N.
of a treatise on Kaṇāda's seven Vaiśeṣika categories.
—सप्तपदी-गमन, अम्, n. the walking together
round the nuptial fire in seven steps, (see साप्त-
पदीन.)
—सप्त-पर्ण, अस्, ई, अम्, seven-leaved;
(अस्), m. the tree Alstonia or Echites Scholaris; (ई),
f. the sensitive plant; (अम्), n. a sort of sweetmeat
(made of grapes, pomegranates, dates, with sugar,
spices, honey, and ghee).
—सप्त-पाताल, अम्, n.
the seven Pātālas or regions under the earth, (see
पाताल, the names Ni-tala and Gabhasti-mat are
sometimes substituted for Rasā-tala and Talātala.)
—सप्त-पुत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having seven sons, hav-
ing seven children.
—सप्त-पुत्र-सू, ऊस्, f. the
mother of seven sons or children.
—सप्त-प्रकृति,
अयस्, f. pl. the seven constituent parts of a kingdom
(viz. the king, his ministers, ally, territory, fortress,
army, and treasury, see प्रकृति).
—सप्त-बुद्ध-
स्तोत्र, अम्, n., N. of a Buddhist work.
—सप्त-
बुध्न, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having seven bottoms or
foundations.
—सप्त-भद्र, अस्, m. the Śirīṣa
tree.
—सप्त-भूमिक or सप्त-भौम, अस्, आ,
अम्, having seven stories, seven stories high.
—सप्त-
मृत्तिका, आस्, f. pl. seven earths collected from seven
places and used in certain solemn rites.
—सप्त-
योजनी, f. a distance or extent of seven Yojanas.
—सप्त-रक्त, अम्, n. the seven red-coloured
parts of the body (viz. the palms of the hands, soles
of the feet, nails, corners of the eyes, tongue, palate,
and lips).
—सप्त-रश्मि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. seven-
rayed, having seven rays; (इस्), m. epithet of Agni.
